meta.name: linkedin-hook-extractor
meta.description: Reverse-engineer the hook formula from a viral LinkedIn post URL. Returns which of the 20 canonical 2026 formulas it uses (anaphora, R.I.P., year-pivot, time-anchor, curiosity-gap, contrarian, comment-gate, emotional cold-open, named-gratitude, and 11 more), why it worked, and a blank template. Use to learn from a competitor's post, not to write your own (use linkedin-post-writer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解爆款领英帖的钩子套路
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想研究竞争对手的领英帖为何火爆
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to learn why competitors' LinkedIn posts go viral

howto.what: 粘贴一条爆款 LinkedIn 帖子的链接后,Claude 会判断它用的是 16 种钩子公式中的哪一种(附置信度),拆出钩子行、正文结构与收尾方式,说明它为什么有效,并给出一份填好空位标记、可套用你自己主题的模板,同时标出原帖里可能过时的写法。
howto.when: 当你找到一条想研究的爆款帖子、想复刻某位创作者的行文模式,或在用 linkedin-post-writer 起草前先取一个已验证的结构时。

say.text: 帮我拆解这条爆款帖子的钩子:https://...
say.note: 返回公式编号、结构与空白模板

say.text: 这条帖子用的是哪种钩子公式?
say.note: 给出最匹配的公式和置信度

say.text: 把这个结构做成模板,换成我的主题
say.note: 产出带 {slot} 空位的模板

howto.what_en: Paste a viral LinkedIn post URL and Claude reports which of the 16 hook formulas it uses (with a confidence score), breaks down the hook lines and body structure, explains why it worked, and returns a blank template with slots for your own topic.
howto.when_en: When you find a viral post you want to study, want to copy a creator's pattern, or need a proven structure before drafting your own post with linkedin-post-writer.

say_en.text: Break down the hook in this viral post: https://...
say_en.note: Returns formula ID, structure and blank template

say_en.text: Which hook formula does this post use?
say_en.note: Gives the best-fitting formula and confidence score

say_en.text: Turn that structure into a template for my topic
